conditions: Rank 4 needs Liked Chemistry with every member as well as standing. KIM chats, bounties and gifts give Chemistry, not standing.
Hold back one of each of the six small treasures; Rank 3 and Rank 5 each eat a full set.
The 385,000 cr in rank-up fees is on top of the 80,000 cr build.
bonuses: Treasures pay Big Bytes Pizza 2,500, Argon Burger Meal 1,500, the others 750; the Air Support treasure tracker pings them all.
Once you have access, all three Temporal Archimedea missions pay a flat 15,000.

conditions: Untradeable, so everything comes from your own standing.
bonuses: Buy the EFV-5 Jupiter from Minerva on the same visit.
